concept_territories.name: Signal Observatory
concept_territories.semantic_premise: The experience behaves like a calibrated observatory that turns scattered research signals into a legible field of evidence.
concept_territories.typography_strategy: Large editorial propositions paired with compact technical annotations and calm reading text.
concept_territories.composition_model: A stable reading axis surrounded by peripheral evidence constellations and measured boundary crossings.
concept_territories.image_logic: Documentary research imagery is cropped as evidence specimens and sequenced from context to consequence.

concept_territories.name: Working Field Manual
concept_territories.semantic_premise: The experience behaves like a well-used field manual that helps practitioners move from observation to repeatable action.
concept_territories.typography_strategy: Compact grotesk headings, numbered procedures, and generous long-form reading measures.
concept_territories.composition_model: Tabbed chapters, margin notes, and sequential procedural blocks organized on a utilitarian modular grid.
concept_territories.image_logic: Images appear as annotated field records with dates, captions, and explicit provenance.

concept_territories.name: Living Index
concept_territories.semantic_premise: The experience behaves like a living index whose relationships reveal how individual projects form a coherent research program.
concept_territories.typography_strategy: A restrained humanist text face with elastic index labels and high-contrast relationship headlines.
concept_territories.composition_model: An asymmetric relational grid that alternates index density with spacious narrative expansions.
concept_territories.image_logic: Project imagery is grouped by relationship and changes scale according to evidentiary importance.

visual_grammar.narrative_premise: A calibrated observatory turns scattered research signals into an inspectable and human-readable field of evidence.
non_color_invariants: A stable central reading axis with evidence entering from the perimeter
Technical annotations aligned to visible source artifacts
Scale changes that correspond to evidentiary importance rather than decoration

motif_mappings.meaning_or_job: Connect a claim to the visible artifact or relationship that supports it.
Separate source material from interpretation while preserving provenance.

responsive_transformations: Peripheral evidence moves into an ordered inline sequence on small screens
Wide comparison pairs become swipe-free stacked claim-and-source units
Decorative sightlines simplify while semantic source links remain visible
